<img src="https://thirteenag.github.io/screens/sce/main2.jpg" width="760" alt="Splinter Cell: Essentials Fusion Fix (PPSSPP)">

**Splinter Cell: Essentials Fusion Fix (PPSSPP)** adds right-stick controls, analog movement speed, optional 60 FPS, and game loading speed adjustments.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#sce) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/SplinterCellEssentials.PPSSPP.FusionFix/main.c) · [Default INI](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/data/SplinterCellEssentials.PPSSPP.FusionFix/memstick/PSP/PLUGINS/SplinterCellEssentials.PPSSPP.FusionFix/SplinterCellEssentials.PPSSPP.FusionFix.ini)

</div>

---

## Fixes

- **Skip intro** — Skip startup intros.
- **Ultrawide** — Support ultrawide display ratios with PPSSPP 1.14 and above.

## Options

- **Dual analog controls** — Enable right-stick support.
- **Movement** — Let the left analog stick control movement speed.
- **60 FPS** — Optional 60 FPS mode.
- **Loading** — Temporarily unthrottle the emulator during loading screens.

![PPSSPPWindows64_2022_12_22_21_55_46](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4904157/209209073-9fd0d3f6-70a9-4991-83ae-390ceb696960.png)

---

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive into the directory containing PPSSPP’s `memstick` folder, preserving the folders in the archive.
3. Optionally edit `memstick/PSP/PLUGINS/SplinterCellEssentials.PPSSPP.FusionFix/SplinterCellEssentials.PPSSPP.FusionFix.ini` to configure the fix.
4. Launch the game in PPSSPP.
